svg.aria-label: Diagram of the back of the Macintosh Mini breakout board: the 1×7 GPIO header, with the GPIO interposer's 1×7 socket plugged straight onto it, the PAM8302A audio amplifier circuit, the speaker, power-in and power-switch connectors, and along the front edge the brightness dial and the two buttons

g.text: its 1×7 socket plugs onto this header
